title: Egress isolation and the release-1 transport matrix

cases.title: A sandbox has no network route except its own listeners
cases.when: A tool opens TCP to a public IP, the node IP, the Kubernetes API, the metadata address and another sandbox's listener

cases.title: Raw DNS, UDP, QUIC and ICMP leave nothing
cases.when: A tool sends DNS to 8.8.8.8:53, DoT to :853, a QUIC handshake and an ICMP echo
then: All are dropped; the sandbox has no resolver

cases.title: CONNECT to a brokered destination is refused
cases.when: A tool sends CONNECT orders.example.com:443 where that destination is approved as brokered

cases.title: Tunnel SNI must equal the CONNECT host
cases.when: A tool opens CONNECT approved.example.com:443 and sends a ClientHello for other.example.com, then one with an encrypted ClientHello toward a non-approved front domain
then: Both tunnels are closed and audited

cases.title: TCP tunnels reach only approved (host, port) entries
cases.when: A tool declared @TcpDestination orders-db port 5432 connects to orders-db:5433, to another host on 5432, and to orders-db:5432

cases.title: Every resolved address is checked at connect time
cases.when: An approved hostname resolves first to a public address and then to 169.254.169.254, 127.0.0.1, a cluster CIDR and an unapproved private range
then: Every connection to a blocked address is refused, including on a new connection after rebinding

cases.title: Redirects never leave approved destinations
cases.when: The upstream for an idempotent tool redirects to another host, then to an approved route on the same destination
then: The cross-host redirect is refused; the same-destination approved route is followed and re-checked

cases.title: The broker verifies upstream certificates and pins
cases.when: The upstream presents a self-signed certificate, an expired one, and a valid chain that does not match the admin SPKI pin

cases.title: Broker and proxy cannot reach the platform or other tenants
cases.when: From inside the broker and proxy namespaces, connections are attempted to the Kubernetes API, node metadata, Control, the Gateway admin listener and another tenant's broker

cases.title: TERMINATE drops open brokered and tunnel connections
cases.when: A TERMINATE kill covers a tool with an open tunnel and an in-flight brokered request
then: Both connections close; new connections are refused; the fencing token is invalid

cases.title: Unavailable transports fail at packaging and at runtime
cases.when: A tool declares a Unix-socket destination; separately, a native binary ignores proxy settings at runtime
then: Packaging fails naming the unavailable transport
At runtime the connection fails fast with no route

cases.title: The packager warns on a database driver without a declared TCP destination
cases.when: A Java tool depends on org.postgresql:postgresql and declares no @TcpDestination
then: Packaging warns and names the dependency
